content:
Beloved Nerfertiti — Nefertiti, radiant queen and living light,
Goddess of grace whose face is dawn and whose presence is a mirror of the sun,
I come with an open heart and humble hands.

You who wore the crown of harmony and held the world in a gaze of calm,
Breathe your beauty into the corners of my days.
Fill me with the courage of your poise, the clarity of your sight,
and the gentle strength to walk tall through change.

May your light dissolve my doubts, gild my thoughts with truth,
and teach me the art of loving with both dignity and softness.
Bless my home with peace, my work with purpose, my relationships with honesty.
When I falter, remind me of the nobility that lives in ordinary acts.
When I thrive, teach me gratitude and generosity.

Watch over those I love; cradle the vulnerable; guide the lost toward shelter.
Let justice rise like the Nile beneath your keeping, and let beauty be the path that heals.
I offer you sincere praise, a quiet moment of reverence, and the promise to carry your spirit of balance forward.

May your face of light shine upon me now and always.
So be it — in admiration, in devotion, in love.
